## Household and background

Quinn Abernathy (born September 2, 1986) is single with no dependents and lives at 245 Birchwood Terrace in Anytown. ## Interview

**Q.** Are you actively writing — is this a business for you?

**A.** No. I wrote the book once, years ago, and teach full-time now. The royalties just arrive — my preparer says that's Schedule E, not Schedule C.

**Q.** What are the $1,286 of expenses?

**A.** My agent takes a small collection fee, and I paid a lawyer to review a permissions request. Those come out of my own records — the publisher's 1099 only shows the gross royalties.

**Q.** Any depletion — is this an oil, gas, or mineral royalty?

**A.** No, it's a book. Nothing to deplete.

**Q.** Any dependents? Could anyone claim you as a dependent? Are you blind, disabled, or a student? A U.S. citizen all year?

**A.** No to all of those, and yes — citizen all year.
